ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a two-bus system. A generation source SG1 is connected to the left side of Bus 1, labeled V1 = 1∠0 pu; Bus 1 and Bus 2 are connected through a line whose series impedance is Z = j0.5 pu. Below Bus 1 there is a load SD1 = 1 pu, and below Bus 2 there is a load SD2 = 1 pu. A shunt capacitor to ground is connected to the right side of Bus 2, labeled QG2. The problem gives |V2| = 1 pu. Reasoning: According to the specified method, regard the branch from Bus 1 to Bus 2 as a lossless reactance X = 0.5 pu, and take V1 = 1∠0, V2 = 1∠δ. The current injected from Bus 2 into the line is I2 = (V2 - V1)/(jX). Therefore, the complex power injected from Bus 2 into the line is S2 = V2 I2*. Since X = 0.5, 1/X = 2, it can be obtained that S2 = j2(1 - e^{jδ}) = 2 sin δ + j 2(1 - cos δ). The real power load SD2 of Bus 2 is 1 pu, so the net real power injection of Bus 2 is -1 pu, therefore 2 sin δ = -1, giving δ = -30°. Substitute into the reactive power injection expression: Q2 = 2(1 - cos(-30°)) = 2(1 - 0.8660) = 0.2679 pu. The load diagram of Bus 2 gives only 1 pu real power demand, and the only reactive power source at Bus 2 is the capacitor, therefore the required positive reactive power injection is equal to the capacitor rated reactive power QG2 ≈ 0.268 pu.

推理：按指定方法，取 Bus 2 电压为局部相位参考，因此 V2 = 1∠0 = 1 pu。Bus 2 从线路吸收的净复功率为负荷实功率减去电容无功注入，即 S2 = 1 - jQG2。由 S = V I*，有 I* = S2 / V2 = 1 - jQG2，所以线路电流 I = 1 + jQG2。线路阻抗为 j0.5 pu，从 Bus 2 到 Bus 1 的电压关系可写为 V1 = V2 + j0.5 I。因此 V1 = 1 + j0.5(1 + jQG2) = 1 + j0.5 - 0.5QG2 = (1 - 0.5QG2) + j0.5。图中 Bus 1 电压幅值为 1 pu，所以 |V1| = 1：
(1 - 0.5QG2)^2 + (0.5)^2 = 1。
因此 (1 - 0.5QG2)^2 = 0.75，得到 1 - 0.5QG2 = ±0.8660。解得 QG2 = 0.268 pu 或 3.732 pu。选择较小且物理上常用的补偿值，QG2 = 0.268 pu。
